T: Wax on. Wax off. Eat up.
D: A new kid in town learns karate from an apartment handyman to stand up to bullies.
P: Serve the mains when Mr Miyagi catches the fly with chopsticks.
S: Steamed edamame tossed with flaky salt, chilli and sesame oil, with cucumber batons quick-pickled in rice vinegar and sesame. Chopsticks only. Steam 400g frozen edamame in their pods for 4 minutes and toss with flaky salt, a pinch of chilli flakes and 2 tsp sesame oil. Cut a Lebanese cucumber into batons and pickle for 20 minutes in 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and a pinch of salt, then drain and scatter with toasted sesame seeds. Serve both in small bowls with chopsticks only.
Mr Miyagi grew up in Okinawa

Purple sweet potato sliced paper thin and fried crisp, dusted with sea salt and togarashi, with a creamy wasabi mayo for dipping. Peel 2 purple sweet potatoes and slice paper thin on a mandoline. Soak in cold water for 20 minutes, then dry very well on tea towels. Heat 1L vegetable oil to 170C and fry in small batches for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp. Drain and toss with sea salt and a pinch of shichimi togarashi. Mix 150g mayo with 2 tsp wasabi paste and a squeeze of lime for dipping.
Broccolini blanched 1 minute, charred in a smoking pan with garlic, tossed in oyster sauce and sesame oil, stood up in a little dish like a row of trees.
M: the plate Daniel tips over Johnny's head

Big plate of spaghetti in a rich tomato and beef sauce with parmesan. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 700g passata and 1 tsp oregano and simmer 30 minutes. Cook 400g spaghetti, toss with the sauce and serve with 50g grated parmesan and basil.
a bowl from Miyagi's home island

Pork belly braised soft in soy, mirin and ginger, on thick wheat noodles in a bonito and chicken broth, topped with pickled ginger and spring onion. Cut 800g pork belly into 4cm pieces, blanch 5 minutes and drain. Simmer with 125ml soy, 125ml mirin, 3 tbsp sugar, sliced ginger and 750ml water for 2 hours until tender. Heat 1.5L chicken stock with 2 tsp dashi powder and 2 tbsp of the braising liquid. Cook 800g fresh udon for 2 minutes and divide into bowls. Pour over broth, add the pork and top with pickled ginger and spring onion.
W: Glutinous rice flour, sugar and water stirred into a dough, steamed 20 minutes, kneaded smooth, wrapped around balls of red bean paste and dusted with cornflour.
K: Sencha steeped just off the boil with fresh ginger and lemon, sweetened with honey and served hot in small cups or poured over ice. Simmer 1L water with a 4cm piece of sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then let it cool to about 80C. Add 4 tsp sencha and steep for 1 minute only, then strain. Stir in 2 tbsp honey and a squeeze of lemon. Pour into small cups, or cool completely and serve over ice with a thin slice of lemon.
